environment: authorized cloud desktop, official Blockbench 5.2.2; no game client
method: Directly open seven frozen bbmodel files, observe actual editor viewport, capture original full-window JPEG bytes. No asset edits or saves. Each own tab closed after capture.
final_observed_state: New Tab, no modal, responsive viewport; handed back to Tavern reviewer
global_render_sides: Auto, settings visibly checked and captured; unchanged
camera: Isometric Right (2:1); North controls on scenes03 and05. Source at X-20 is screen right/lower in ISO and right in North; RP at X+20 screen left/upper in ISO and left in North.

observations.01: Complete pair visible, counterphase feet and arms distinguishable.
observations.02: Complete standing pair visible; arms, hands and unbent legs visible.
observations.03: Complete ISO and North pair visible; turned head with front-facing body visible under declared synthetic inputs.
observations.04: Complete standing pair visible; head yaw and shoulders visible.
observations.05: Complete ISO and North pair visible. Shared teal striping/stippling near sleeve/forearm junction in both source and RP was retained as a diagnostic, not dismissed or called a runtime bug. Independent image/geometry review remains needed.
observations.06: Complete slim seated-take phase0 pair with arms and feet visible.
observations.07: Complete slim seated-take phase0.5 pair visible using same UI camera preset and scroll amount as06; no claim of exact camera matrices or pixel equivalence.

limits: Both sides use one common Blockbench CubeRenderer, not independent native engines.
Static pose snapshots only; no playback, controller timing, transitions, native look-at queries, game alpha/material ordering, LIVE, Minecraft client or BDS was exercised.
Occluded inner surfaces are not accepted by these views.
Seven new cases supplement earlier frozen customer cases and do not imply every rig/clip is covered.

public_projection.change: Only operator label generalized. Original capture receipt retained privately unchanged, not published or reconstructible.
